papers.title: What Makes a Good Symbol for Hybrid Discrete-Continuous Planning?
papers.summary: Symbols for robot planning are invented by identifying discrete commitments that simplify solving continuous optimization problems, reducing cost while preserving quality.

papers.title: Not All Features Are Created Equal: A Mechanistic Study of Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.summary: A mechanistic interpretability study of vision-language-action policies reveals that motor programs are bound to absolute coordinates and ignores visual scene changes, with sparse autoencoder analysis separating instruction encoding and motor generation across architectures.

papers.title: BiDex-100: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation Across 100+ Simulation Tasks
papers.summary: BiDex-100 is a simulation benchmark for bimanual dexterous manipulation that evaluates vision-language-action models across diverse tasks, robustness variants, and demonstration scales.

papers.title: Training the Whole Agent, Not Just the Model
papers.summary: HarnessAdapt-RL jointly trains a coding policy and adapts its evaluation harness via mechanism-level skills and evolving tools, improving benchmark pass rates over fixed-harness reinforcement learning.

papers.title: Axiomatic World Modeling for Physics Reasoning
papers.summary: RLAWM improves physics reasoning by penalizing divergence between a model's internal world model and true physical axioms through hierarchical modeling and solving rewards.
